*Perfect for dipping a quesadilla.*

## Ingredients

- ⅔ cup of Mexican cream
- hot sauce (I use Valentina®)
- 1 lime (juice)

## Instructions

1. Mix all the ingredients together.
2. Add hot sauce to your desired spice level.
